Average points per player

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Maximum points per player
output: SELECT player, MAX(points) FROM games GROUP BY player;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
player with total points above 1000
output: SELECT player, SUM(points) FROM games GROUP BY player HAVING SUM(points) > 1000;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
player groups having more than 5 records
output: SELECT player, COUNT(*) FROM games GROUP BY player HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Count records per player
output: SELECT player, COUNT(*) FROM games GROUP BY player;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Total points grouped by player ordered by total desc
output: SELECT player, SUM(points) AS tot FROM games GROUP BY player ORDER BY tot DESC;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Minimum points per player
output: SELECT player, MIN(points) FROM games GROUP BY player;

instruction:

Average points where points > 0
output: SELECT AVG(points) FROM games WHERE points > 0;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Total points for records after 2024
output: SELECT SUM(points) FROM games;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Rollup of player with totals
output: SELECT player, SUM(points) FROM games GROUP BY ROLLUP(player);

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Cube of player with totals
output: SELECT player, SUM(points) FROM games GROUP BY CUBE(player);

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Standard deviation of points
output: SELECT STDDEV(points) FROM games;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Variance of points
output: SELECT VARIANCE(points) FROM games;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Total points for each player having at least 2 rows
output: SELECT player, SUM(points) FROM games GROUP BY player HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Median of points per player
output: SELECT player, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY points) FROM games GROUP BY player;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Sum and count combined per player
output: SELECT player, SUM(points), COUNT(*) FROM games GROUP BY player;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Grouping by two columns player and points
output: SELECT player, points, COUNT(*) FROM games GROUP BY player, points;

instruction:
Schema: games(id, player, points, played_on)
Number of distinct played_on per player
output: SELECT player, COUNT(DISTINCT played_on) FROM games GROUP BY player;
